source.title: How to Use Reference Images in Blender
source.creator: Darrin Lile

analysis.study_scope: Pipeline-access check for Blender reference-image setup.

episodes.problem: Scene clutter from unorganized setup objects.
episodes.observed_fact: Default collection hidden; new collection created and named 'Ref_Images'.
episodes.instructor_claim: Grouping reference images separately keeps the workspace clean.
episodes.interpretation: Organizing reference objects in a dedicated collection simplifies visibility management.
episodes.modeling_decision: Create a dedicated collection for all reference image planes.
episodes.visible_action: Right-clicked Outliner, selected New Collection, renamed to Ref_Images.
episodes.spoken_reason: Keep things clean by placing references into a distinct collection.
episodes.transferable_principle: Isolate helper and reference assets into separate collections for scene organization.

episodes.problem: Reference image imports aligned to perspective view angle rather than world axes.
episodes.observed_fact: Image added in perspective view faces the active view angle; user undoes operation.
episodes.instructor_claim: Reference images default to facing the active camera view upon insertion.
episodes.interpretation: Adding references in perspective creates arbitrary rotation offsets.
episodes.reference_evidence: Tilted image plane loaded in viewport.
episodes.modeling_decision: Undo perspective placement and switch to orthographic view before loading.
episodes.visible_action: Undid insertion, opened view pie menu (~ key), and selected Front view.
episodes.spoken_reason: To align the image properly, switch to Front view first.
episodes.failure: Adding reference image while in perspective view.
episodes.correction: Undo action, switch to Front orthographic view, then reload image.
episodes.alternatives: Clear transformation rotation in Transform properties panel.
episodes.transferable_principle: Align viewport to an orthographic axis before inserting reference images.

episodes.problem: Unlabeled reference objects in multi-view setups cause confusion.
episodes.observed_fact: Images imported in Front, Right, and Back views; objects renamed via F2.
episodes.instructor_claim: Renaming image objects immediately prevents confusion during modeling.
episodes.interpretation: Consistent naming identifies reference planes in Outliner quickly.
episodes.reference_evidence: Three orthogonal image empties in scene labeled Front, Side, and Back.
episodes.modeling_decision: Import orthographic images in corresponding views and name each immediately.
episodes.visible_action: Pressed F2 on selected image empties and typed 'Front', 'Side', and 'Back'.
episodes.spoken_reason: Rename imports right away to maintain clear scene tracking.
episodes.transferable_principle: Name reference empties by orientation immediately upon creation.

episodes.problem: Reverse side of image plane obscures model when viewing from opposite angles.
episodes.observed_fact: Side display option set to 'Front' in Data properties panel.
episodes.instructor_claim: Setting Side display to Front hides the back side of reference images.
episodes.interpretation: Single-sided visibility prevents reference planes from blocking opposite views.
episodes.reference_evidence: Image empty turns invisible when viewed from behind.
episodes.modeling_decision: Restrict image display to front faces only.
episodes.visible_action: Selected image empty, navigated to Data Properties, clicked 'Front' under Side.
episodes.spoken_reason: Ensure image is only visible from the front so back angles stay clear.
episodes.transferable_principle: Restrict reference image display to single-sided visibility to reduce viewport clutter.

episodes.problem: Reference image planes obstruct 3D mesh inspection in perspective mode.
episodes.observed_fact: Perspective checkbox unchecked in Object Data Properties.
episodes.instructor_claim: Disabling Perspective hides images in 3D perspective view while keeping them in orthographic views.
episodes.interpretation: Hiding references in perspective leaves 3D navigation unobstructed.
episodes.reference_evidence: Image plane hides upon tumbling camera into perspective.
episodes.modeling_decision: Disable perspective visibility for reference empties.
episodes.visible_action: Unchecked 'Perspective' under Show options in Data Properties.
episodes.spoken_reason: Keep perspective view clear of reference planes while modeling.
episodes.transferable_principle: Disable perspective visibility on reference planes to keep 3D viewports clear.

episodes.problem: Opaque reference images hide geometry positioned behind them.
episodes.observed_fact: Opacity enabled and slider value reduced to ~0.2.
episodes.instructor_claim: Lowering opacity lets you see working mesh overlay on top of references.
episodes.interpretation: Semi-transparent image planes allow simultaneous tracking of mesh and guide contours.
episodes.reference_evidence: Mesh cube visible through semi-transparent reference plane.
episodes.modeling_decision: Enable opacity and reduce alpha transparency level.
episodes.visible_action: Checked Opacity box and dragged slider to ~0.2.
episodes.spoken_reason: Adjust transparency to see both the object and reference clearly.
episodes.transferable_principle: Lower reference plane opacity to align geometry against guide contours.

episodes.problem: Accidental selection of reference images during viewport mesh editing.
episodes.observed_fact: Selection toggle enabled in Outliner filter menu; selectable icon disabled on reference collection.
episodes.instructor_claim: Disabling selection on the reference collection prevents accidental misclicks.
episodes.interpretation: Locking reference selectability protects background assets during transform operations.
episodes.reference_evidence: Outliner selection arrow toggled off for 'Ref_Images' collection.
episodes.modeling_decision: Disable selectability for the entire reference collection.
episodes.visible_action: Opened Outliner Restriction Toggles, enabled Selectable filter, clicked selection icon on Ref_Images collection.
episodes.spoken_reason: Prevent clicking reference images instead of the model while working.
episodes.transferable_principle: Disable selectability on reference collections to protect planes from accidental clicks.

limitations: Demonstrates reference plane setup only; does not cover actual 3D geometry construction or multi-view mesh alignment.
